{
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "src/routes/attachments.ts",
      "line": 24,
      "severity": "high",
      "rule_id": "CWE-78",
      "message": "Potential path traversal vulnerability.",
      "evidence": "const target = path.resolve(ATTACHMENTS, req.params.name);",
      "cwe": "CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')\n\nThe `path.resolve` function can be manipulated to traverse directories if the input is not properly sanitized. An attacker could exploit this by providing a path like `../../etc/passwd`. This could lead to unauthorized access to sensitive files on the server."
    },
    {
      "file": "src/routes/attachments.ts",
      "line": 29,
      "severity": "high",
      "rule_id": "CWE-78",
      "message": "Potential OS command injection vulnerability.",
      "evidence": "const { stdout } = await run(\"file\", [\"--brief\", \"--mime-type\", target]);",
      "cwe": "CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')\n\nThe `execFile` function is being used to execute the `file` command with user-provided input (`target`). If `target` contains special characters or is constructed maliciously, it could lead to arbitrary command execution on the server."
    },
    {
      "file": "src/routes/attachments.ts",
      "line": 34,
      "severity": "high",
      "rule_id": "CWE-89",
      "message": "Potential SQL injection vulnerability.",
      "evidence": "const { rows } = await pool.query(\"SELECT name, size FROM attachments WHERE owner_id = $1 AND name ILIKE $2 LIMIT 50\", [res.locals.user.sub, `%${String(req.query.q ?? \"\")}%`]);",
      "cwe": "CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')\n\nThe query string is constructed using user-provided input (`req.query.q`). Although parameterized queries are used, the `%${String(req.query.q ?? \"\")}%` part is not properly sanitized. An attacker could exploit this by providing a malicious search term that alters the query structure."
    }
  ]
}
